newsitem.title: UK: NWE naphtha edge down amid lack of buying interst.
newsitem.headline: NWE naphtha edge down amid lack of buying interst.

text.p: NWE naphtha was knocked $2 or so lower by easier crude for much of the day and sparse buying interest.

Dealers said physical activity was slow with swaps talk barely better. A February swap was done early in the morning at $225, but by late afternoon levels had slipped to $221-222 cif NWE. Petchem demand remains limited and most buyers have pushed their requirement into February.
"Recent deals seem to be trader to trader," said one supplier who was looking for bids of around $224 for a small parcel.
